A little about us

Thoughtful travel. A more personal experience.

At Wafa Travel and Tour, every great journey begins with listening. Whether you are arranging a flight, planning an Umrah trip with family, looking for a comfortable hotel or making a Hajj inquiry, we aim to make the first steps clear and convenient.

Tell us your destination, travel dates and preferences. Our team can discuss your requirements, explain the next steps and help you understand the options available.
